# Venkatesh Prabhatha Kana

> Portfolio of Venkatesh Prabhatha Kana, a full-stack developer and M.Tech Software Engineering student building modern web applications with React, TypeScript, Next.js, NestJS, Tailwind CSS, and Firebase.

This is the official portfolio of Venkatesh Prabhatha Kana. It presents his technical skills, education, professional experience, and selected software projects.

## About

Venkatesh Prabhatha Kana is a full-stack developer from Karnataka, India, pursuing an M.Tech in Software Engineering at Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology (MANIT), Bhopal. He completed a B.E. in Computer Science Engineering at Sri Krishnarajendra Silver Jubilee Technological Institute (SKSJTI).

He has professional experience as a Full Stack Developer Intern at Inventech Info Solutions and is interested in building reliable, accessible, and user-focused software.

## Selected Projects

### Momentum

An offline-first personal productivity application for task planning, time tracking, scheduling, streaks, calendar planning, reminders, and next-action guidance. Core data is stored locally so the app can work without an account, backend, or internet connection.

Technologies include Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, Dexie, IndexedDB, and Capacitor for Android.

### Employee Management System

A full-stack employee management application with role-based access control, JWT authentication, employee CRUD operations, RESTful APIs, and a multi-level user hierarchy.

Technologies include React, NestJS, MySQL, TypeScript, JWT, and Ant Design.

### Task Flow Navigator

A multi-functional React application with secure login, form validation, mobile OTP verification, pagination, and a complete to-do list workflow for adding, editing, deleting, and completing tasks.

Technologies include React, Ant Design, JavaScript, CSS, and state management.

### Form Validation

A company registration application with validation for PAN, TAN, and GST fields, country-state cascading selectors, responsive design, and real-time validation feedback.

Technologies include React, Ant Design, JavaScript, pattern recognition, and form validation.
